description: College problems, Event planning, Productivity, Education, Public-awareness campaigns

questions.badPrompt: Students aren't attending college events. What should we do?
questions.context: A university student council facing low attendance (<15%) across cultural and technical campus events.
missingElements: Root cause diagnostic analysis (Timing clashes with exams, lack of incentives, poor promotion channels)
Target audience segmentation (Hostelers vs Day scholars, Undergrads vs Postgrads)
Low-cost engagement and gamification mechanics (Attendance perks, academic credit, food vouchers)
Multi-channel outreach plan (WhatsApp Class Reps, Instagram Reels, Department Ambassadors)
Structured 4-week execution roadmap with measurable attendance target KPIs

questions.badPrompt: Plan a college event.
questions.context: Organizing a 24-hour national hackathon with 500 participants on a tight budget.
missingElements: Event scope, theme, and timeline breakdown (T-minus milestones)
Budget limits, sponsorship deliverables, and volunteer shifts
Risk mitigation & contingency plans (power outage, food catering, WiFi failure)
Judging criteria and participant deliverables
Structured master operational schedule

questions.badPrompt: Fix the campus parking problem.
questions.context: Severe vehicle congestion and lack of two-wheeler slots during morning peak hours.
missingElements: Stakeholder analysis (students, faculty, administrative staff)
Short-term operational fixes vs long-term infrastructural solutions
Enforcement and incentive mechanisms (digital passes, carpool zoning)
Phased implementation roadmap and measurable congestion KPIs

questions.badPrompt: Reduce cafeteria food waste by 50%.
questions.context: A university campus dining hall generating 300kg of organic food waste daily.
missingElements: Supply chain & portioning audit methodology
Surplus redistribution protocols with local food banks/shelters
On-campus composting and bio-gas conversion feasibility metrics
Student incentive programs and measurable weekly audit targets

questions.badPrompt: Set up a student mental health peer-support network.
questions.context: Creating a confidential, student-led psychological wellness initiative on campus.
missingElements: Volunteer screening and psychological first-aid training framework
Confidentiality safeguards and data privacy protocols
Emergency escalation pathways to licensed clinical professionals
Awareness outreach strategy to destigmatize help-seeking

questions.badPrompt: How to stop students from using AI to cheat on assignments?
questions.context: A university academic council balancing academic integrity with constructive AI literacy.
missingElements: Redesigned assessment methodologies (Oral defenses, process-based portfolios, in-class practicals)
Clear institutional AI usage policy guidelines (Permitted brainstorming vs prohibited plagiarism)
Faculty training on AI-assisted rubric grading and detection limitations
Student honor code covenant and positive AI adoption incentives

questions.badPrompt: Improve campus hostel internet connectivity on a budget.
questions.context: Hostels with 1,200 residents suffering bandwidth choking and dead zones during evening hours.
missingElements: Network traffic management & Quality of Service (QoS) bandwidth allocation rules (Prioritizing academic domains)
Low-cost mesh WiFi extender deployment map and channel interference optimization
Peak-hour bandwidth quota policies and fair usage thresholds
Student IT volunteer maintenance roster and ticketing system

questions.badPrompt: Create a campus e-waste recycling drive.
questions.context: A student club collecting discarded laptops, phones, cables, and circuit boards across campus.
missingElements: Logistical drop-off station network across academic blocks and hostels
Certified e-waste recycling vendor partnership & safe data destruction guarantees
Gamified collection incentives (Department leaderboard prizes, coupon rewards)
Public awareness campaign highlighting heavy-metal toxicity risks

questions.badPrompt: How can our college club get corporate sponsorships?
questions.context: A robotics club seeking ₹2,00,000 in industry funding for building an autonomous Mars rover prototype.
missingElements: Structured corporate pitch dossier (Title Sponsor, Hardware Partner, Lab Mentorship tiers)
Tangible sponsor ROI deliverables (Direct student hiring access, brand logo on rover, tech workshop branding)
Target corporate outreach list (Automotive companies, robotics firms, tech conglomerates)
Cold email outreach scripts and executive meeting pitch structure

questions.badPrompt: Make our college campus 100% single-use plastic free.
questions.context: An environmental green council eliminating plastic water bottles, straws, and cutlery across all food courts.
missingElements: Sustainable alternative supply chain sourcing (Biodegradable areca nut plates, steel water refill kiosks)
Vendor contract compliance transition period and micro-subsidy model
Student buy-in campaign ('BYOB: Bring Your Own Bottle' discounts)
Enforcement policy and campus audit verification milestones

questions.badPrompt: Design an alumni mentorship program for career guidance.
questions.context: Connecting 500 final-year engineering students with working industry alumni mentors.
missingElements: Mentor-mentee matching criteria and algorithm factors (Domain interest, tech stack, career aspirations)
Structured 8-week curriculum guide (Resume review, mock interviews, portfolio audit, networking tips)
Platform & communication protocols (Slack/Discord community guidelines, monthly check-in tracking)
Program feedback mechanisms and annual alumni recognition awards

questions.badPrompt: How to handle a sudden power failure during a major live event?
questions.context: An emergency contingency protocol for a 2,000-person auditorium concert during an unexpected blackout.
missingElements: Immediate emergency response checklist (Emergency lighting, backup generator transfer SLA < 60s)
Crowd control & evacuation safety procedures (Stage manager announcements, illuminated exit guides)
Audio/visual equipment surge protection protocols
Roles and responsibilities table for stage crew, security, and volunteers

questions.badPrompt: Improve student attendance in morning 8 AM classes.
questions.context: Academic departments reporting average 8 AM class attendance under 45%.
missingElements: Behavioral science & nudge theory incentives (Interactive morning quizzes with bonus points)
Curriculum redesign (Flipping classroom lectures into hands-on group lab activities)
Campus logistics optimizations (Hostel breakfast timing alignment, morning shuttle frequency)
Student-faculty dialogue and schedule rebalancing proposals

questions.badPrompt: Organize a city-wide blood donation camp at college.
questions.context: A student Red Cross society aiming to collect 500 units of blood in a single day.
missingElements: Certified hospital blood bank partnership & medical supervision requirements
Pre-screening health safety checklist (Hemoglobin tests, donor eligibility guidelines, resting area)
Hour-by-hour appointment slot booking system to prevent overcrowding
Donor care package (Refreshments, donor certificate, digital blood card)

questions.badPrompt: How to prevent cyberbullying on anonymous campus confession pages?
questions.context: Unmoderated Instagram confession pages spreading defamatory rumors and toxic harassment among students.
missingElements: Digital safety reporting & escalation protocol for victims
Collaboration with student leaders and page administrators for strict moderation guidelines
Campus legal and cybercell awareness workshops
Anonymous peer-counseling support and positive social media culture campaigns

questions.badPrompt: Create a peer-to-peer textbook and notes exchange library.
questions.context: Students spending excessive money each semester on physical reference books and study materials.
missingElements: Digital inventory cataloging system (QR code scanning, book condition grading: Like New/Good/Fair)
Lending & return deposit policy to prevent lost books
Physical drop-box and pickup logistics inside central library
Crowdsourced verified topper-notes upload platform with upvoting

questions.badPrompt: How to resolve a toxic team conflict in a semester capstone project?
questions.context: A 4-person senior engineering team where 1 member is doing zero work and 2 members are fighting over leadership.
missingElements: Objective contribution audit framework (GitHub commit logs, task board assignments)
Constructive mediation facilitation script for faculty advisors
Workload re-allocation agreement with written milestone sign-offs
Individual grading grading rubric based on peer evaluations

questions.badPrompt: Set up a campus stray animal welfare and vaccination program.
questions.context: A growing population of campus dogs leading to student safety complaints and animal welfare concerns.
missingElements: Animal NGO and certified veterinarian partnership for ABC (Animal Birth Control) and anti-rabies vaccination
Designated feeding zones away from main academic footpaths
Student volunteer feeding and health monitoring roster
Campus community awareness and dog-bite prevention safety education

questions.badPrompt: Design a high-impact campus anti-ragging awareness campaign.
questions.context: Welcoming 1,500 incoming first-year students to foster a safe, inclusive, zero-tolerance environment.
missingElements: 24x7 anonymous emergency SOS helpline & physical complaint box locations
Senior-junior icebreaking mentorship orientation workshops
Legal penal consequences infographic posters and digital orientation modules
Faculty flying squad patrol schedule in hostels and cafeteria zones

questions.badPrompt: How to manage long queues at the college printing station before exams?
questions.context: Chaotic 45-minute lines at the campus photocopy center on assignment submission mornings.
missingElements: Cloud-print submission portal (Students upload PDF, pay online via UPI, pick up via token #)
Self-service automated printing kiosk deployment feasibility
Off-peak printing discounts to spread morning demand
Department-level digital assignment submission policy mandates

questions.badPrompt: Create a student internship placement preparation bootcamp.
questions.context: A 4-week crash course preparing 300 non-CS students for tech and consulting campus placements.
missingElements: Week-by-week curriculum (Aptitude tests, Data structures & algorithms, System design, Case interviews)
Daily practice schedule with timed mock assessments
Alumni resume review clinics and live behavioral interview simulations
Placement readiness tracking dashboard and performance scoring

questions.badPrompt: Reduce electricity wastage across college lecture halls.
questions.context: Lights, fans, and ACs left running in empty classrooms costing the institution ₹50,000 in wasted power monthly.
missingElements: Low-cost IoT motion sensor and timer deployment schedule
Classroom energy-warden student volunteer responsibility system
Departmental energy conservation competition with saved-cost grant rewards
Facility management end-of-day automated power cutoff checklist

questions.badPrompt: How to organize an emergency relief collection drive for flood victims?
questions.context: A student union mobilizing emergency supplies (ration kits, blankets, medicines) following regional flood devastation.
missingElements: Prioritized essential supply checklist verified with disaster management authorities
Campus collection hubs, sorting protocols, and waterproof packaging logistics
Direct transport & delivery coordination with on-ground rescue personnel
Transparent donation accounting ledger and live community updates

questions.badPrompt: Improve the quality and hygiene of campus drinking water dispensers.
questions.context: Student complaints regarding water purifier filter maintenance and irregular temperature control.
missingElements: Weekly water quality testing protocol (TDS levels, microbial testing, pH balance audit)
Preventive maintenance calendar with public QR code service log tags on each cooler
Student escalation channel for immediate filter replacement requests
Sanitation schedule for dispenser nozzles and drainage trays

questions.badPrompt: Create a sustainable startup incubation cell for student entrepreneurs.
questions.context: Setting up a campus incubator to help student teams convert final-year projects into commercial startups.
missingElements: Seed grant application & pitch evaluation framework
Legal, patent IP, and company incorporation mentorship support
Co-working space access rules and shared lab equipment booking system
Annual Demo Day investor showcase with angel investors and VC partners
